title: Introduction
desc: What designme.dev is: free components for AI agent products, in HTML or React, in two styles with light and dark mode.

title: Installation
desc: Add components to your project with the designme CLI, as HTML, CSS and JavaScript or as React components.

title: Theming
desc: Switch between Soft and Blueprint, light and dark, and set your own accent and its roles.

title: Accessibility
desc: The roles, keyboard support, reduced motion and contrast work built into the components.

title: Using with AI
desc: Point a coding agent at the Markdown copy of every page and at llms.txt, and prompt it to install components with the CLI.
